Portia Grid

Logistics & Data Intelligence

Intelligent Fleet & Data Management

Portia Grid is a powerful internal tool we built to help logistics companies manage their entire fleet of delivery trucks. From tracking vehicle locations to scheduling maintenance, everything is handled in one centralized dashboard.

Challenge

The client was managing 50+ delivery trucks using spreadsheets and phone calls. Maintenance was often missed, leading to breakdowns and delays. They had no visibility into their fleet's real-time status.

Solution

We built a custom web platform that provides real-time GPS tracking, automated maintenance scheduling based on mileage and time, driver assignment management, and comprehensive reporting.
